headline: Economy stalls in August, two days after Bank of Canada's hike
summary: The stories that stayed in the briefing most this week: Economy stalls in August, two days after Bank of Canada's hike; Carney reports 'good conversation' with Trump as trade teams keep talking; Trump says Iran war will end 'one way or the other' as Hormuz plan waits.

top.headline: Economy stalls in August, two days after Bank of Canada's hike
top.what: Statistics Canada says the economy was flat in August and probably shrank 0.1% in September, a weak backdrop for the Bank of Canada's first rate increase since 2023.
top.why: In the briefing on 4 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Carney reports 'good conversation' with Trump as trade teams keep talking
top.what: Prime Minister Mark Carney says he had a good call with Donald Trump on a possible Canada-U.S. trade deal, with officials on both sides to keep working over the coming weeks, though tariffs remain in place.
top.why: In the briefing on 4 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Trump says Iran war will end 'one way or the other' as Hormuz plan waits
top.what: Trump warned that the war will end very soon either through a deal or by force, while Iran's talks with Qatari mediators on a two-day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz still hinge on Washington's reply.
top.why: In the briefing on 4 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Ontario's deficit swells to $16.9 billion as tariffs delay balanced budget
top.what: Finance Minister Peter Bethlenfalvy's fall economic statement projects a record $16.9-billion deficit this year and $36 billion over three years, pushing a balanced budget beyond 2028.
top.why: In the briefing on 4 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Trump closes in Kansas as Democrats lead most key Senate polls
top.what: More than 53 million Americans voted early, and Trump ended his weekend with a Sunday evening rally in Salina, Kansas, where Democrat Adam Hamilton leads recent polls against Sen. Roger Marshall.
top.why: In the briefing on 4 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: U.S. economy grows 3.4% in third quarter as inflation cools
top.what: The U.S. economy expanded at a 3.4% annual rate from July to September, faster than the spring, while a key inflation gauge eased.
top.why: In the briefing on 4 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Kherson truce ends as Russian strikes leave Ukrainians without power
top.what: A short humanitarian ceasefire around occupied Oleshky in Kherson region expired Sunday night, as Russian strikes on the power grid kept outages in place across Ukraine.
top.why: In the briefing on 4 of the last 7 days.

top.headline: Final count leaves Netanyahu's bloc at 53 seats, short of a majority
top.what: Israel faces weeks of coalition talks after final results gave neither Netanyahu's bloc nor Gadi Eisenkot's a 61-seat majority, and Likud claimed the vote was stolen.
top.why: In the briefing on 3 of the last 7 days.
